literal_meaning: টুক-টুক শব্দের অনুকরণ বা অল্প-অল্প (ছোট ছোট শিশুদের নির্দেশক অনুনাদিক শব্দ)
example_sentences_in_english: The village toddlers are playing in the field.
My little ones are going to school today.
note: This term is an endearing colloquialism used in Bengali households to refer to small children, often with a nurturing connotation.
